prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, natural soft black hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver barrel-shaped weight, a copper miniature anvil, a copper square-sided cowbell, a tin hammer head, a copper ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold rings. Extra long nails in matching polished onyx.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished banded onyx fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy black onyx surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID creamy-white concentric banding flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved banded onyx.

LEFT Cracks: the banded onyx body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right forearm and one at her belly, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw dark grey stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the banded onyx is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: one leg crossed in front of the other, both hands hanging loosely at her sides.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme peep-toe platform stiletto pumps in cream white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved banded onyx right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Egyptian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth warm light-brown skin, a gentle soft smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a tin barrel-shaped weight, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished amber.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished honey amber fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid amber curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted amber sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep honey-orange amber surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID tiny trapped air bubbles and dark inclusions swirling through every section, glass-smooth polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved honey amber.

RIGHT Cracks: the honey amber body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his left calf, and two chipped-off pieces, one at his right hip and one at his right forearm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw dark-brown resin with a rough unpolished surface inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the honey amber is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
